## Walkthrough Adds/updates control-plane scheduling in manifests and operator: manifests gain a control-plane toleration and/or nodeSelector; the operator deployment controller gains an unexported hook that sets the control-plane nodeSelector based on the cluster Infrastructure topology; tests and a namespace annotation were added. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Manifest tolerations**
`bindata/kube-storage-version-migrator/deployment.yaml`, `manifests/07_deployment-ibm-cloud-managed.yaml`|Added a `NoSchedule` toleration for `node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane` (operator: `Exists`) alongside the existing `node-role.kubernetes.io/master` toleration.| |**Manifest nodeSelector & toleration**
`manifests/07_deployment.yaml`|Replaced `nodeSelector` key from `node-role.kubernetes.io/master: ""` to `node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: ""`; also added a `control-plane` toleration while keeping the `master` toleration.| |**Namespace annotation**
`bindata/kube-storage-version-migrator/namespace.yaml`|Added `openshift.io/node-selector: ""` annotation to the `openshift-kube-storage-version-migrator` Namespace metadata.| |**Deployment controller**
`pkg/operator/deploymentcontroller/deployment.go`|Added unexported `setControlPlaneNodeSelector` hook and registered it in the migrator deployment controller; the hook reads `Infrastructure` "cluster" and sets `spec.template.spec.nodeSelector["node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"] = ""` when topology ≠ `ExternalTopologyMode`. Updated comment in `setDesiredReplicas`.| |**Unit tests**
`pkg/operator/deploymentcontroller/deployment_test.go`|Added `Test_setControlPlaneNodeSelector` covering HighlyAvailable, SingleReplica, and External topology modes and asserting nodeSelector presence/absence.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Controller participant InfrastructureAPI participant Deployment Controller->>InfrastructureAPI: Get "cluster" Infrastructure InfrastructureAPI-->>Controller: return status.controlPlaneTopology alt topology != ExternalTopologyMode Controller->>Deployment: ensure PodTemplate.Spec.NodeSelector exists Controller->>Deployment: set nodeSelector["node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"] = "" else topology == ExternalTopologyMode Controller->>Deployment: do not modify nodeSelector end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

only standard Go unit tests added. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR adds standard Go unit tests, not Ginkgo e2e tests, so the custom check for Ginkgo e2e test assumptions is not applicable. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The PR's setControlPlaneNodeSelector and setDesiredReplicas hooks inspect infrastructure.Status.ControlPlaneTopology, skip control-plane nodeSelector on External clusters, compute replica counts from actual control-plane nodes, target only the specific control-plane taint, exclude arbiter nodes, and respect supported OpenShift topologies. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR changes contain only manifest YAML files and a new setControlPlaneNodeSelector function with no stdout emissions that could violate OTE binary test communication. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. The test file modified contains only standard Go unit tests using the testing package, not Ginkgo e2e tests with patterns like It(), Describe(), or Context(). |

>## Summary
>
>The migrator deployment had no `nodeSelector`, so pods could land on worker nodes despite being a core control-plane component. Every other OpenShift control-plane operator pins its operand to control-plane nodes via `nodeSelector`, but the migrator was the exception after a previous attempt ([PR #92](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-kube-storage-version-migrator-operator/pull/92)) was [reverted](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-kube-storage-version-migrator-operator/pull/93) because it broke HyperShift (no control-plane nodes exist in guest clusters).
>
>This PR adds a topology-aware `DeploymentHookFunc` that:
>- Sets `nodeSelector: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane` for all topologies **except** External (HyperShift), where it is skipped to avoid pods remaining Pending
>- Adds `openshift.io/node-selector: ""` to the operand namespace to prevent cluster-level `defaultNodeSelector` from constraining migrator pods to non-control-plane nodes
>- Adds the `node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane` toleration alongside the existing `master` toleration for forward compatibility
>- Updates the operator deployment `nodeSelector` from `master` to `control-plane`
>
>### Changes
>- **`bindata/.../namespace.yaml`** — add `openshift.io/node-selector: ""` annotation to override `defaultNodeSelector`
>- **`bindata/.../deployment.yaml`** — add `control-plane` toleration alongside existing `master`
>- **`manifests/07_deployment.yaml`** — operator `nodeSelector` `master` → `control-plane`; add `control-plane` toleration alongside existing `master`
>- **`manifests/07_deployment-ibm-cloud-managed.yaml`** — add `control-plane` toleration alongside existing `master` (generated via `make update`)
>- **`pkg/operator/deploymentcontroller/deployment.go`** — new `setControlPlaneNodeSelector` hook
>- **`pkg/operator/deploymentcontroller/deployment_test.go`** — unit tests for HA, SNO, and External topologies
>
>## Test plan
>- [x] Unit tests pass for `setControlPlaneNodeSelector` across HA, SNO, and External topologies
>- [ ] CI e2e passes (standard HA topology)
>- [ ] Verify with `/payload-job` on SNO and HyperShift topologies
